audience_note: The reservoir forced the relocation of more than 57,000 people from the lower Zambezi valley (Gwembe Tonga, per the scholarly article).
title: Kariba Dam, Zambezi River
summary: Kariba Dam across the Zambezi between Zambia and Zimbabwe was designed by the French engineer André Coyne, and its wall and power station contract went to the Italian consortium Impresit on 16 July 1956. Excavation, construction and the first generator took place between 1956 and 1960. Its reservoir displaced more than 57,000 people.

uncertainty.note: The Zambezi River Authority gives 1956 to 1960 for excavation, construction and commissioning of the first generator. End is the present: the dam operates.

reviewer_note: Crest length is 617 m on the ZRA technical page; other pages give 579 m and one ZRA press release 716 m, which I did not open.
